batch: Revamp S3 Public, Intake and Organise: Wave 5 organiser room regroup with consent and disclosure tests C-01 to C-10, plus the honest-proof guard fix from PR 269
kind: Application change (room layout and one read-only view) with its tests. No SQL, migration, API, switch or permission change.
sensitive: yes (consent, tenant scope). Guardian PASS required.
findingsNote: No gap register entry is created or changed.
status: Built on branch revamp/public over main 43325f9. CI on the exact pushed head is the verifier; see the pull request.
specSource: docs/revamp/specs/programme-consent.md and ADR-075 with its 3 November amendment
newFilesOnly: tests/integration/revamp-programme-consent.test.ts (vitest on real SQL through the restricted customer services; C-01, C-02, C-03, C-04, C-05, C-06, C-07, C-08)
tests/operator/revamp-programme-room.spec.ts (Playwright over the real programme list and room; C-09, C-10)
tests/integration/proof-claims.ts and proof-claims.test.ts (the honest-proof guard helper and its red fixtures)
editedOwnFiles: tests/e2e/verification/ws-a/intake-payload.spec.ts: the proof guard now reads text per block and uses the helper.
reviewFindingClosed: PR 269 thread on the proof guard (Codex P2, confirmed by the Guardian): a sentence containing 'no' or 'not' anywhere no longer hides a claim, and a denial in one block no longer reaches the next. A claim is excused only when a denial word sits in its own clause before it. Red fixtures: 'Trusted by 100 companies with no subscription fees.', a denial in one paragraph next to a claim in the next, and a denial at the end of one block before a claim at the start of the next. The guard still passes on all 15 public pages.

map.C-01: A member, an outsider, a participant and the organiser of another programme are denied the projection (which carries the counts) under this programme, under their own workspace and across both; the denial message is identical for an existing and a non-existing programme; an organiser cannot share or withdraw for a participant.
map.C-02: No share, a withdrawn share and a removed registration: the company is null and 'currentSharedCompany' is missing, never an empty object, and the old name is nowhere in the body; a withdrawn registration is no longer a participant and counts no one; a revoked source is state UNAVAILABLE with no counts, not zero. The 'Not shared' words in the browser are covered by tests/operator/v3-programme-projections-ui.spec.ts.
map.C-03: After cancel and re-apply with another company, the organiser body holds neither company's name, the row is not ready, and the participant's own view says sourceChanged. The longer same-version replacement case stays in customer-programme-projections.test.ts.
map.C-04: Sharing a mission objective alone gives meetings state NOT_SHARED with no counts; the separate count permission gives AVAILABLE; withdrawing it returns to NOT_SHARED.
map.C-05: scheduled and qualifiedHeld are two numbers; an unqualified held meeting is neither; a participant-reported 'meeting held' outcome never changes qualifiedHeld; a recorded qualification moves qualifiedHeld to 1 while scheduled stays 0.
map.C-06: The organiser body is searched by text and by key for the seeded meeting title, counterparty names, location, brief, outcome note, opportunity title and attribution, the participant's own note and objective summary, the mission, meeting, opportunity, request and link ids; none appears. The meetings object has exactly six keys. The walkers are proven to read the body (the participant label and the top-level keys are found). The HTML half of C-06 is not covered here.
map.C-07: With one enrolled participant who has not shared and one registered participant who is not enrolled: 'N of M' comes from server totals (0 of 2, then 1 of 2), the first misses only currentSharedCompany, the second misses confirmedPlace, currentEligibility, currentTerms and currentSharedCompany, and the definition string is the ADR-075 one. 'Not measured yet' for unavailable data is a browser case and is not covered here.
map.C-08: No key in the organiser body names a quote, price, amount, currency, budget, value, deal, cost, margin, revenue or fee. The labelling of organiser revenue versus Corridra fees in the economics view is not covered here.
map.C-09: Opens every group, then checks that each of the seven original views (overview, people, companies, agenda, plan, terms, money) still has its section id and is reachable (a button controls it or it sits inside a section a button controls), that the room's ids frozen before the regroup are all present, and where each view now sits (companies in people, agenda in plan, money in terms). Group labels asserted.
map.C-10: With the switch off: the five group buttons, every original view section present and reachable, no companies or agenda section, no Companies and readiness, Timed agenda or Meeting results heading, no sharing panel, no 'Meeting counts are' sentence, and in Results the line 'Meeting counts are not available for this programme.' with no count and no ': 0'.
map.Results states: C-04 C-05: two separate numbers (2 and 1) with the not-qualified note; C-02 C-04: NOT_SHARED reads 'Not shared' with no numbers; C-07: unread data and UNAVAILABLE sources read 'Not measured yet' with no numbers and no ': 0'.

notCovered: No visual acceptance on the real signed-in page: the rendered fixture was looked at (five group buttons, Participants and Companies stacked) with no CSS added. No UX gate run locally; the CI ux job is the check.
Production switch values are not observed. CORRIDRA_UX_PROGRAMME (the room) and the projections switch stay as the owner set them.

receipts.vitest: revamp-programme-consent.test.ts 5 passed and proof-claims.test.ts 20 passed, exit 0 with no unhandled errors; the existing room, trip and teaching-layer tests (64) and customer-programme-projections.test.ts (15) pass unchanged.
receipts.playwright: operator config, local: revamp-programme-room.spec.ts 8 passed and ux-programme-room.spec.ts 11 passed; v3-programme-projections-ui.spec.ts 28 passed unchanged. intake-payload.spec.ts 53 passed, 1 skipped.

notRun: The full integration and operator suites (CI runs them on the pushed head).
decision: Guardian answer, 4 Nov 2026: regroup with the projections switch off too (one code path); the layout is not tied to CORRIDRA_CUSTOMER_PROGRAMME_PROJECTIONS_ENABLED, which stays a disclosure control. C-10 amended to: with the switch off, Companies, Agenda conflicts and counts are absent, and every existing view, section id, action and link is reachable as before.
applicationChanges: apps/web/lib/programme-room.ts: adds roomGroups (five groups and the views each holds) and roomViewLabels. roomLenses and programmeProjectionLenses are unchanged.

apps/web/app/account/delegations/programme-room.tsx: the room offers five group buttons. Each group mounts the views it holds under their existing section ids `${programmeId}-<view>` (the view with the group's own key keeps that id on the group section; the others are inner sections). Mounting on first open, hidden-not-removed, the overview note, the sharedMoneyNote text and the refresh on change of group are as before.

apps/web/app/account/delegations/programme-projections.tsx: a third read-only view, 'results', in the existing owner panel. It uses the same read and the same data; it shows Scheduled meetings and Qualified held meetings as two numbers, 'Not shared' when no participant allowed counts, and 'Not measured yet' when the data is unread or the sources are unavailable, never a zero it did not measure. No new field, audience or disclosure.

apps/web/app/account/delegations/customer-programmes.tsx: supplies the Results panel: the results view with the switch on, and the line 'Meeting counts are not available for this programme.' with it off. Results is offered only where participants are on, so the bare room still has one view.
exportsPanel: The exports panel is a workspace-wide tab (Pricing, series and exports) shared across programmes and mounted below the programme list. Moving it into one room would move an action and break its programme selector, so Results keeps it where it is and says so in the same words the Money view already uses for fee schedules. Flagged to the Guardian.

changedExistingTestStrings.file: tests/operator/ux-programme-room.spec.ts (only the label strings the test clicks or lists; every assertion stays)
changes: the five-name list ['Overview','People','Plan and report','Terms and places','Money'] -> ['Overview','Participants and eligibility','Programme and meetings','Terms and fees','Results']

guardianConditionsOn5fd1ff4.1 proof guard checks every match: proofClaimsIn now scans every match of every pattern (a global copy with matchAll) and excuses a sentence only if every match is denied in its own clause. New red fixtures, red against the old single-match code (2 failed, 18 passed) and green now (20): 'We never fake testimonials, read our testimonials.', 'We never fake testimonials and read our testimonials.', 'We do not say trusted by anyone, but Trusted by 100 companies.'
guardianConditionsOn5fd1ff4.2 C-01 exact denial: Every attempt now runs one at a time and the exact message is asserted: 'Programme owner or admin required' for all ten organiser-side reads (member, outsider, another organiser and participant, on this programme and under the other workspace, another programme under this workspace, a programme that does not exist) and 'Own registration required' when the organiser shares for a participant. Also removed a real defect in my own test: three promises were started before any was awaited, which made vitest report an unhandled rejection; the run is now clean (exit 0, no unhandled errors).
guardianConditionsOn5fd1ff4.3 browser cases: revamp-programme-room.spec.ts adds C-06 (the projection answers with a seeded meeting title, counterparty, contact, note, opportunity value, mission id and company website, contact and private summary; the room text and HTML, including hidden groups, show none of them and do show the allowed company name and scheduled count), C-07 (the room shows '1 of 4 active participants ready' from the server, and with the data unreadable shows 'Not measured yet' in the boarding line and in Results and no 'N of M ready'), C-08 (the Terms and fees group shows 'Fees due from participants' and a separate 'Corridra service fee' inside costs and as its own record kind, the sentence that Corridra does not collect, hold or send money, never 'Corridra revenue', and none of the seeded participant quote, trade value or price).
guardianConditionsOn5fd1ff4.4 C-10 and room tests to the five labels: Done in commit 518ee84: the five groups in both switch states, every section id, action and href kept, the C-09 frozen id list unchanged and passing.
